description: The cover pairs in the divisibility order on the positive divisors of 12 are exactly (1,2), (1,3), (2,4), (2,6), (3,6), (4,12), and (6,12).
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor_covers (a b : Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.Divisor12) :
  a ⋖ b ↔
    (a, b) ∈
      {(Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 1 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 2 ⋯),
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 1 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 3 ⋯),
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 2 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯),
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 2 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯),
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 3 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯),
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 4 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 12 ⋯),
        (Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 6 ⋯, Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.divisor 12 ⋯)}
